quality: Line and branch coverage at 80% or more, every route opened by a spec and checked with axe, no skipped test, and main passing.
speed: Each test job finishes within the ten-minute build.
consumption: Billed test minutes no more than the jobs' speed goals add up to, and shell probes run on hosted CI, not a workstation.
